product: Nationwide mail-in and in-office service to sell jewelry, watches, diamonds and gold, or to borrow against them

claims.claim: Sell or borrow using your jewelry: one valuation, two ways to use it
Free insured overnight shipping, both ways
Instant online quote up front; item then confirmed by Diamond Banc's experienced experts, in person at a local office or after insured shipment
Customers may ship the item in or visit a local office to book an appointment
Funding within 24 hours of accepting your offer
No obligation to accept any offer
5.0 out of 5 with 10,000+ reviews combined across Google, Trustpilot, and Yelp

16 active office markets: Aventura, Boca Raton, Coral Gables, Tampa, West Palm Beach, Orlando, Sarasota (FL); Atlanta, Roswell (GA); Kansas City, Columbia, St. Louis (MO); Nashville (TN); Scottsdale (AZ); Beverly Hills, San Diego (CA). Pasadena is coming soon and is not counted as active.
Founded in 2007 by Mills Menser, a third-generation jeweler

Current featured team: Mills Menser (Founder & Owner); Devin Smith (Executive Vice President, Revenue & Operations); Kyle Z. Cook (Vice President, Underwriting & Logistics); Jordan Isaacs (Director of Transactions, Head Buyer & Lender, Rolex Specialist); David Fernandez (Regional Director, Miami Markets); Jodi Hudson (Director, Tampa); Deena Maali (Director, Orlando)
Team members are referred to as experienced experts; no individual is described as GIA certified in customer-facing copy
Diamonds: natural diamonds and engagement rings only; Diamond Banc does not purchase lab-grown stones
Watches: Rolex and other Swiss timepieces, evaluated by Rolex- and watch-trained experts
Designer jewelry brands evaluated: Cartier, Tiffany & Co., Van Cleef & Arpels, Bvlgari

testimonials.quote: After watching countless videos on YouTube, I reached out to Diamond Banc and was introduced to Jordan. He made the process seamless and simple and answered all of my questions. The entire process, from initial contact to securing a loan took less than 48 hours. I am very impressed with their process and level of customer service and highly recommend them to anyone needing to access their jewelry's equity. Thank you again!
testimonials.name: Sebastian C.

testimonials.quote: I got 4 different estimates. Diamond Banc was the clear winner. Christine was a great advocate in making sure I got the best deal. Everyone was delightful and the location of the office was beautiful and convenient. Highly recommend.
testimonials.name: Shirley Farrah

testimonials.quote: Christine Weimer was extremely friendly, professional, and helpful. She made the whole process quick and easy, and everything went very smoothly. Excellent customer service. Highly recommended!
testimonials.name: Mehmet Ali Ünal

testimonials_note: Three published testimonials are used verbatim with accurate attribution. Sebastian C., Shirley Farrah, and Mehmet Ali Ünal all appear in the Google review feed on Diamond Banc's loans page and are labeled as Google reviews. Not represented as Trustpilot reviews. Aggregate proof (5.0/5, 10,000+ combined reviews, A+ BBB) is presented separately.
